notes.title: Patch Notes | Shadow Brawlers
notes.notes:
Hey Ninjas!

[h1]Updated and Fixed Stuff[/h1]

[list]
[*] New Input systems should work with (almost) any GamePad 
[*] We lowered a bit the time needed to unlock characters, weapons, powerups and game modes
[*] Optional Access to the Beta version of the Replay Feature (use with discretion) 
[*] Fixed Input Configuration for Keyboard
[*] A new special stage at the end of the challenge mode
[*] Now 'Patata' is unlocked by completing all challenge mode levels
[*] Now 'SteamB' (temp name) gets unlocked in ruins (instead of Patata)
[*] New PowerUp "Decoy" available! 
[*] Lowering audio and music volume now makes sense!
[*] Some scenery elements from several maps where revised
[*] A few informative popups added here and there
[*] Updated the animation on Chaos Saw and Chaos Destiny to better reflect while they are not dangerous
[*] Bot distribution in some challenge mode maps where updated
[*] Added a Vfx when a secret mobility exploit is used
[*] Fixed a thing where selecting palettes manually was futile
[*] Fixed a thing with the input that snapped the attack direction to rectangular angles sometimes
[*] We updated some texts and some menus details
[*]  Fixed a lot of minor stuff, mostly achievements
[/list]


[h1] Join us Ninja! [/h1]

Discord:https://discord.gg/9pgKrzw

notes.title: Hello World!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33517250/0bc3d1e68c1bb73d7e6399ffd133ed07085d08da.jpg[/img]


[b]We are Team Guazú[/b], a small team of developers about to release our first commercial videogame attempt to stop being freelancers for once, so we can dedicate ourselves to making games which make us feel so good.

[b]Shadow Brawlers is a party game made with one (or two) ton(s) of love. [/b]Focusing not only on the polishing of minimalist aesthetics and fluid animations, but also on a fast and sufficiently deep combat system. Fight like an alienated, hide to surprise your opponents, return attacks to the button masters and choose from several options of weapons, items and modes. These are the things that make this a solid and fun plataform brawler game.

[b]From the beginning we make this game to entertain ourselves, but we are comfident that other people will enjoy it as much as we do.[/b]
We invite you to follow us and if you have any questions, you can swing by our Twitter  or we will reply by steam

Twitter: https://twitter.com/teamguazu

Stay tuned and thanks
